converter: ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0 on Linux x86_64 under Xvfb emulation; package SHA-256 c432002cc688f89ddf6a68ad68e877cd16da1d99ab8729386009c552cf73beb5

fullGraphExperiment.construction: Starting from the ODA DXF of the original two-TABLE DWG, replace only the two selected ACAD_TABLE CELL_VALUE envelopes with the cached writer group order, flags 6 and original 48/52-byte source payloads. The rest of the original drawing graph is retained; ASCII line endings were normalized. TABLECONTENT copies remain untouched.
fullGraphExperiment.result: Both ODA conversions produced files with no .err for these two paths. Each selected ACAD_TABLE re-export has flags 0, type 512, no groups 92 or 310, and retains the displayed label. This observation does not prove the intermediate DWG payload survived.

oneCellExperiment.inputs: Previously generated two selected cells in ASCII and binary; each partial output has a TABLE group-2 block name *P5I_SELECTED but no corresponding separate block record in the file.
oneCellExperiment.result: All four DXFs produced DWGs. Re-export emitted .err files reporting Empty Record name: <AcDbTable> (680F); the resulting DXFs are not accepted as complete output. This separate missing-block issue prevents treating these as standalone native interchange evidence.

intermediateReaderBoundary.currentLibdxfrw: On the original source it reads 2 TABLE grids with both expected type-512 raw payloads. On both ODA full-graph resaves and the one-cell resaves it reports TABLE callbacks but no parsed rows for these values; no payload conclusion follows.
intermediateReaderBoundary.acadsharp: The instrumented ACadSharp 3.6.15 DWG reader independently returns the original two TABLE grids and matching General strings. For both ODA full-graph resaves it returns zero completed TABLE entities; traces enter the TABLE frames, but this is not an independent readback of the selected values.

limits: No conclusion is drawn that ODA retains or discards the 48/52-byte DWG value: the re-exported display cache can originate from other retained TABLE data.
No AutoCAD native open or independent readback of the selected values after resave was obtained.
Scratch drawings and source derivatives remain outside the repository; no support claim is promoted.
nextStep: Find a reader that completes the ODA-resaved AC1021 TABLE frames or capture native producer/consumer values. For standalone controls, supply a valid named block and its complete reciprocal graph; keep existing strict refusal.
